sewer-diagonal.name: Diagonal (Balmes – Via Laietana)
sewer-diagonal.whatCouldFail: On a T10 design storm the Resilience Atlas shows this Diagonal axis among the places where the sewer cannot carry the flow, so water leaves gullies and drains onto the street.
sewer-diagonal.preventiveAction: Inspect and clear gullies and sumps along the axis before heavy rain.
sewer-diagonal.geometryNote: Simplified corridor along the axis the atlas names, from Plaça de Francesc Macià through Balmes to the Via Laietana meridian. Not the PICBA hydraulic mesh.

sewer-poblenou.name: Poblenou
sewer-poblenou.whatCouldFail: The same T10 capacity map names Poblenou among the areas where drains surcharge onto the street. The centre of Poblenou is one of the places the atlas says stays critical as drainage shortfalls worsen.
sewer-poblenou.preventiveAction: Check gullies in central Poblenou before heavy rain, including low points along the rambla.
sewer-poblenou.geometryNote: Simplified outline of the Poblenou neighborhood named in the atlas. Not a flood-depth contour.

sewer-sant-andreu.name: Sant Andreu
sewer-sant-andreu.whatCouldFail: When the Resilience Atlas compares today’s flood hazard with medium-term climate scenarios, Sant Andreu is one of the areas where drainage shortfalls get worse and water reaches the street.
sewer-sant-andreu.preventiveAction: Inspect gullies and known low points in Sant Andreu before heavy rain.
sewer-sant-andreu.geometryNote: Simplified outline of Sant Andreu de Palomar, the neighborhood the atlas names. Not a flood-depth contour.

sewer-parallel-raval.name: Paral·lel – Sant Antoni – Raval
sewer-parallel-raval.whatCouldFail: PICBA’s T10 map groups Paral·lel, Sant Antoni and the Raval among the axes where the sewer surcharges and water comes out onto the street.
sewer-parallel-raval.preventiveAction: Clear gullies along Paral·lel and on the Raval side of Ronda de Sant Pau before heavy rain.
sewer-parallel-raval.geometryNote: Simplified trace of the Paral·lel–Sant Antoni–Raval axes named together in the atlas. Not the PICBA mesh.

sewer-badal.name: Badal axis
sewer-badal.whatCouldFail: The Resilience Atlas hazard comparison marks the Badal axis among the places where drainage shortfalls intensify and drains can surcharge to the street.
sewer-badal.preventiveAction: Inspect gullies along the Badal axis before heavy rain.
sewer-badal.geometryNote: Simplified corridor on the Badal axis named in the atlas. Not a flood-depth contour.

hotspot-macia.name: Diagonal – Plaça de Francesc Macià
hotspot-macia.whatCouldFail: First of the 14 critical urban-flood points in the RESCCUE / PDISBA’19 list. The published hazard is water on the street when drainage surcharges — people walking, and traffic — not a depth.
hotspot-macia.preventiveAction: Inspect inlets around Plaça de Francesc Macià and clear blockages before heavy rain.
hotspot-macia.geometryNote: Point on Plaça de Francesc Macià, the place named in the list.

hotspot-urgell-roma.name: Urgell / Casanova / Avinguda de Roma
hotspot-urgell-roma.whatCouldFail: Named in the RESCCUE / PDISBA’19 list of 14 critical points. The published hazard is street flooding where the drainage network surcharges, with the risk that brings for people walking and for traffic.
hotspot-urgell-roma.preventiveAction: Inspect inlets at the Urgell / Roma junction and clear blockages before heavy rain.
hotspot-urgell-roma.geometryNote: Point at the Urgell / Avinguda de Roma junction in Sant Antoni.

hotspot-parallel.name: Ronda de Sant Pau – Avinguda del Paral·lel
hotspot-parallel.whatCouldFail: Named in the RESCCUE / PDISBA’19 list of 14 critical points. The published hazard is water on the street when drainage surcharges.
hotspot-parallel.preventiveAction: Inspect inlets where Ronda de Sant Pau meets Paral·lel and clear blockages before heavy rain.
hotspot-parallel.geometryNote: Point at the Ronda de Sant Pau / Paral·lel junction.

hotspot-sant-pau.name: Around Carrer de Sant Pau
hotspot-sant-pau.whatCouldFail: Named in the RESCCUE / PDISBA’19 list of 14 critical points, in the Raval. The published hazard is street flooding when drainage surcharges.
hotspot-sant-pau.preventiveAction: Inspect inlets along Carrer de Sant Pau and clear blockages before heavy rain.
hotspot-sant-pau.geometryNote: Point on Carrer de Sant Pau in the Raval.

hotspot-diagonal-bruc.name: Diagonal (Bruc – Roger de Flor)
hotspot-diagonal-bruc.whatCouldFail: Named in the RESCCUE / PDISBA’19 list of 14 critical points, on the Diagonal stretch between Bruc and Roger de Flor. The published hazard is street flooding when drainage surcharges.
hotspot-diagonal-bruc.preventiveAction: Inspect inlets along this stretch of Diagonal and clear blockages before heavy rain.
hotspot-diagonal-bruc.geometryNote: Point on the Diagonal stretch between Carrer del Bruc and Carrer de Roger de Flor.

hotspot-clot-navas.name: Clot – Navas
hotspot-clot-navas.whatCouldFail: Named in the RESCCUE / PDISBA’19 list of 14 critical points. The published hazard is street flooding when drainage surcharges.
hotspot-clot-navas.preventiveAction: Inspect inlets between Clot and Navas and clear blockages before heavy rain.
hotspot-clot-navas.geometryNote: Point between Plaça del Clot and Navas, the pair named in the list.

hotspot-via-augusta.name: Via Augusta – Príncep d’Astúries – Rambla del Prat
hotspot-via-augusta.whatCouldFail: Named in the RESCCUE / PDISBA’19 list of 14 critical points, on the Gràcia corridor of Via Augusta, Príncep d’Astúries and Rambla del Prat. The published hazard is street flooding when drainage surcharges.
hotspot-via-augusta.preventiveAction: Inspect inlets along this Gràcia corridor and clear blockages before heavy rain.
hotspot-via-augusta.geometryNote: Point at Plaça de Gal·la Placídia, on the Via Augusta side of the named corridor.

hotspot-rambla-prim.name: Around Rambla de Prim
hotspot-rambla-prim.whatCouldFail: Named in the RESCCUE / PDISBA’19 list of 14 critical points. The published hazard is street flooding around Rambla de Prim when drainage surcharges.
hotspot-rambla-prim.preventiveAction: Inspect inlets along Rambla de Prim and clear blockages before heavy rain.
hotspot-rambla-prim.geometryNote: Point on Rambla de Prim in la Verneda.

hotspot-llucmajor.name: Plaça de Llucmajor
hotspot-llucmajor.whatCouldFail: Named in the RESCCUE / PDISBA’19 list of 14 critical points. The published hazard is street flooding when drainage surcharges.
hotspot-llucmajor.preventiveAction: Inspect inlets around Plaça de Llucmajor and clear blockages before heavy rain.

hotspot-tajo-cartella.name: Tajo – Cartellà
hotspot-tajo-cartella.whatCouldFail: Named in the RESCCUE / PDISBA’19 list of 14 critical points, at Carrer del Tajo and Carrer de Cartellà in Horta. The published hazard is street flooding when drainage surcharges.
hotspot-tajo-cartella.preventiveAction: Inspect inlets on Tajo and Cartellà and clear blockages before heavy rain.
hotspot-tajo-cartella.geometryNote: Point between Carrer del Tajo and Carrer de Cartellà in Horta.

hotspot-parcerisa.name: Carrer de Parcerisa
hotspot-parcerisa.whatCouldFail: Named in the RESCCUE / PDISBA’19 list of 14 critical points. The published hazard is street flooding when drainage surcharges.
hotspot-parcerisa.preventiveAction: Inspect inlets along Carrer de Parcerisa and clear blockages before heavy rain.
hotspot-parcerisa.geometryNote: Point on Carrer de Parcerisa, in la Marina de Port.

hotspot-riera-blanca.name: Carrer de la Riera Blanca
hotspot-riera-blanca.whatCouldFail: Named in the RESCCUE / PDISBA’19 list of 14 critical points, on the avenue that follows the old Riera Blanca. The published hazard is street flooding when drainage surcharges.
hotspot-riera-blanca.preventiveAction: Inspect inlets along Riera Blanca and clear blockages before heavy rain.
hotspot-riera-blanca.geometryNote: Point on Carrer de la Riera Blanca at the city edge.

hotspot-seat.name: Around SEAT (Zona Franca)
hotspot-seat.whatCouldFail: Named in the RESCCUE / PDISBA’19 list of 14 critical points, around SEAT in the Zona Franca. The published hazard is street flooding when drainage surcharges.
hotspot-seat.preventiveAction: Inspect inlets in this part of the Zona Franca and clear blockages before heavy rain.
hotspot-seat.geometryNote: Point in the Zona Franca area named with SEAT in the list. Not a building outline.

hotspot-tapioles.name: Torrent de Tapioles
hotspot-tapioles.whatCouldFail: Named in the RESCCUE / PDISBA’19 list of 14 critical points. The street carries the torrent’s name; the published hazard is street flooding when drainage surcharges.
hotspot-tapioles.preventiveAction: Inspect inlets along Tapioles and clear blockages before heavy rain.
hotspot-tapioles.geometryNote: Point on Carrer de Tapioles in Poble-sec.

stream-rambla-prim.name: Rambla de Prim corridor
stream-rambla-prim.whatCouldFail: RESCCUE lists the surroundings of Rambla de Prim as a critical flood point. The avenue sits on the drainage corridor that still concentrates runoff toward the Besòs side, so gullies here surcharge to the street.
stream-rambla-prim.preventiveAction: Check gullies along the rambla before heavy rain. The approved tank is future relief, not protection already in service.
stream-rambla-prim.geometryNote: Simplified trace of Rambla de Prim. Not a surveyed channel centerline. Faint lines elsewhere are unnamed ICGC rieres.

stream-cartella.name: Tajo – Cartellà corridor
stream-cartella.whatCouldFail: RESCCUE names Carrer del Tajo and Carrer de Cartellà together as one critical flood point in Horta. Runoff concentrates on these streets and can surcharge to the surface.
stream-cartella.preventiveAction: Clear inlets on both streets before heavy rain.
stream-cartella.geometryNote: Short trace joining Carrer del Tajo and Carrer de Cartellà. Not a surveyed channel centerline.

stream-riera-blanca.name: Riera Blanca
stream-riera-blanca.whatCouldFail: Carrer de la Riera Blanca follows the old riera along the city edge, and RESCCUE still lists it as a critical flood point. Water on that avenue is the published hazard when drainage surcharges.
stream-riera-blanca.preventiveAction: Inspect gullies along Riera Blanca before heavy rain.
stream-riera-blanca.geometryNote: Simplified trace of the avenue named for the riera. Not a surveyed channel centerline.

stream-tapioles.name: Torrent de Tapioles
stream-tapioles.whatCouldFail: RESCCUE names Torrent de Tapioles as a critical point in Poble-sec. The street is the remaining trace of that torrent, and the published hazard is water on the street when it surcharges.
stream-tapioles.preventiveAction: Clear inlets along Tapioles before heavy rain.
stream-tapioles.geometryNote: Simplified trace of Carrer de Tapioles. Not a surveyed channel centerline.

stream-torre-baro.name: Riera traces, Torre Baró
stream-torre-baro.whatCouldFail: The ICGC geotechnical map draws riera lines through Torre Baró. None of the 14 sewer hotspots sits on them. The failure here is torrent and slope runoff, not a surcharge point from the sewer list.
stream-torre-baro.preventiveAction: Inspect slopes, walls and street drainage where these traces meet the streets, before intense rain.
stream-torre-baro.geometryNote: Every RIER_LN line whose midpoint falls inside Torre Baró. The source file does not name the segments.

tank-rambla-prim.name: Rambla de Prim stormwater tank
tank-rambla-prim.whatCouldFail: Mitigation, not a failure mode. The city approved a 94,000 m³ tank on Rambla de Prim to cut sewer surcharge on the lower rambla, the seafront, la Verneda i la Pau, el Besòs i el Maresme and Poblenou. In the July 2025 approval, phase 1 was still under construction, so this map does not treat the tank as already protecting the street.
tank-rambla-prim.preventiveAction: Until it is in service, keep gullies on the rambla clear before heavy rain. Once it operates, confirm it is regulating before a storm.
tank-rambla-prim.geometryNote: Placed on Rambla de Prim, the avenue named in the project. Not a surveyed chamber. Amber means approved, not yet counted as in service.

tank-zona-universitaria.name: Zona Universitària stormwater tank
tank-zona-universitaria.whatCouldFail: Mitigation, not a failure mode. The July 2025 city note counts 15 stormwater tanks already in service and names the university-area tank as the largest. It reduces peak flow on that side of the city. It does not remove risk everywhere else.
tank-zona-universitaria.preventiveAction: Confirm the tank is available to regulate before a storm.
tank-zona-universitaria.geometryNote: Placed at the university area named in that note. Not a surveyed chamber coordinate.

slope-torre-baro.name: Torre Baró
slope-torre-baro.whatCouldFail: Torre Baró faces Collserola. Slope runoff, debris and torrent traces are a different mechanism from the sewer hotspots on the plain, and none of the 14 published sewer points is here. A sewer-only map does not explain this neighborhood.
slope-torre-baro.preventiveAction: Inspect slopes, retaining walls and street drains on the mountain edge before intense rain.
slope-torre-baro.geometryNote: Simplified neighborhood boundary. Not an INUNCAT flood contour and not a depth map.

slope-sant-genis.name: Sant Genís dels Agudells
slope-sant-genis.whatCouldFail: Sant Genís dels Agudells sits on the Collserola edge. Slope and torrent runoff is the hazard civil-protection mapping treats separately from the 14 sewer hotspots, and none of those hotspots is in this neighborhood.
slope-sant-genis.preventiveAction: Inspect slopes and street drains on the mountain edge before intense rain.
slope-sant-genis.geometryNote: Simplified neighborhood boundary. Not an INUNCAT flood contour.

proof-torre-baro-2026-10.name: Torre Baró — cleanup after the rains
proof-torre-baro-2026-10.whatCouldFail: On 7 October 2026 the city sent 13 crews to Torre Baró after mud, slope failures, fallen walls and blocked streets. About twenty incidents were reported, and soil and debris had spread through the neighborhood. There is no sewer hotspot here to point at.
proof-torre-baro-2026-10.preventiveAction: Clear debris and inspect slopes and walls before the next intense rainfall.
proof-torre-baro-2026-10.geometryNote: Plaça dels Eucaliptus, one of the places Betevé named in the cleanup.

proof-sant-andreu-2026-10.name: Sant Andreu — power cuts
proof-sant-andreu-2026-10.whatCouldFail: Betevé, citing Endesa, reported water entering transformer rooms and electrical gear in ground floors and basements. In the 24 hours before 7 October 2026, Sant Andreu accounted for 144 of those incidents. This dot is that district cluster, on top of a neighborhood the sewer atlas already flags.
proof-sant-andreu-2026-10.preventiveAction: Check drainage into basement and transformer rooms in the district before the next heavy rain.
proof-sant-andreu-2026-10.geometryNote: District cluster from that report, not a single building.

proof-gracia-2026-10.name: Gràcia — power cuts
proof-gracia-2026-10.whatCouldFail: Betevé, citing Endesa, reported water entering transformer rooms and electrical gear in ground floors and basements. In the 24 hours before 7 October 2026, Gràcia accounted for 108 of those incidents. The dot sits beside a published sewer hotspot, not instead of one.
proof-gracia-2026-10.preventiveAction: Check drainage into basement and transformer rooms in the district before the next heavy rain.

sources.label: Betevé — earlier cuts, Gràcia among the hardest hit

proof-gracia-2026-10.geometryNote: District cluster near the Via Augusta hotspot. Not a single building.

proof-les-corts-2026-10.name: Les Corts — power cuts
proof-les-corts-2026-10.whatCouldFail: Betevé, citing Endesa, reported water entering transformer rooms and electrical gear in ground floors and basements. In the 24 hours before 7 October 2026, Les Corts accounted for 353 of those incidents — the largest district share in that update.
proof-les-corts-2026-10.preventiveAction: Check drainage into basement and transformer rooms in the district before the next heavy rain.
proof-les-corts-2026-10.geometryNote: District cluster from that report, not a single building and not the rain gauge.

proof-sant-genis-2026-10.name: Sant Genís — landslide on Cànoves
proof-sant-genis-2026-10.whatCouldFail: Betevé reported a landslide on Carrer de Cànoves that cut the street, with a fire-service truck stuck in the debris. That is slope failure. It is not one of the 14 sewer hotspots.
proof-sant-genis-2026-10.preventiveAction: Inspect the slope above the street and clear debris before the next intense rainfall.
proof-sant-genis-2026-10.geometryNote: Carrer de Cànoves, the street named in that report.
